description: Serum sodium 140 mEq/L → 138 mEq/L, still normal
presentation: Patient is a 28 year old man who has urinary frequency despite treatment for a presumed UTI. Patient has nocturia and workup for polyuria was done. CMP and A1c were normal, with serum sodium of 138 mEq/L, but urine sodium and urine osm were both low. What further workup should be done to work up diabetes insipidus or other etiologies?
